workstream: ws_vocab2b (vocab_lists): words whose identity is the set of instances aligned to them
written_before: any computation of this workstream. Read beforehand: vocab/REPORT.txt + vocab.py + vscore.py, softrec REPORT2/REPORT4/REPORT_cas + softrec.py/softrec4.py, lineagefree/REPORT.txt, calib/REPORT.txt, docs/redesign/NOTEBOOK.md from 2026-11-12 23:53 UTC, context_units/NOTEBOOK.txt (odd numbers up to 03:03 UTC) and predeclared.json. method.input: gene order (contigs of genes, DPANN universe) + zca10 whitened ESM++ small vectors. No MMseqs2 family, no taxonomy, no module label at run time.
method.lists: gene lists from the stored zca10 unique-sequence kNN (k 2,000; softrec Lists, identical copies first, tail rank), excluding genes of the gene's own genome (context arms) or of its own data-derived genome group (group arm). Depth K = 1,000 (main), 200 (control).
method.state: contigs as sequences of live nodes; a node is a terminal gene or a word instance (contiguous span: two child nodes plus 0-2 inserted single genes). Every node carries a list of aligned instances in other genomes: a terminal its gene list (each entry a one-gene span with its tail rank), a word the supporting set S that created it (each entry a span in another genome, rank = the worse rank of its two parts).
method.support: for live nodes x, y on one contig with <= 2 intervening single terminal genes, S(x, y) = pairs (p, q), p in list(x), q in list(y), p and q on one contig of another genome, non-overlapping, with <= 2 genes between them, either order, either strand. Per q the best-ranked p is kept (|S| <= |list(y)|). Round 0 only: instances whose two genes are homologs by softrec's exclusion rule (identical sequence or cosine >= max(0.32, min list cutoffs)) are not candidates (the analogue of stage 1's X != Y).
method.counts: n = 1 + distinct supporting genomes (the own genome counts once as the instance itself); E = own term min(1, 6 / m_own) + sum over genomes G of min(1, 6 c_x(G) c_y(G) / m_G), c = list entries in G, m_G = genes of G (softrec's E; exact for terminals, the same random-placement approximation for spans).
method.objective: Lambda(n, E) = n ln(n/E) - n + E nats (0 if n <= E), as stage 1.

evidence_units.ctx (main): Lambda_eff = Lambda(N_eff, E N_eff / n) (= Lambda_genome x N_eff / n). Context of an instance span [s, e]: B = unit(sum of zca10 vectors of the genes at positions [s-50, s-1] and [e+1, e+50] on its contig), raw (no genome centring), the span's own genes excluded; uninformative if the window is empty. Per supporting genome B_G = unit(sum of B over its spans); at most 64 supporting genomes, chosen by a fixed random genome priority (seed 17), plus the instance's own context. c_bar = mean pairwise cosine over the k informative vectors; rho = clip((c_bar - c0 - 2 sd0 sqrt(2 / (k (k - 1)))) / (1 - c0), 0, 1) with c0, sd0 = mean and sd of B.B' over 2,000,000 random pairs of round-0 instance contexts in different genomes (measured on each run's own gene order); k < 2 -> rho = 0. N_eff = n / (1 + (n - 1) rho). Structural minimum N_eff >= 2 (the analogue of stage 1's n >= 2).
evidence_units.grp (reference): lists exclude the own group; n = distinct groups among supporting genomes plus the own group; E = sum over other groups of [1 - prod over the group's genomes of (1 - p_G)] + own term; Lambda(n, E); n >= 2. Groups: $RD/lineagefree/groups/emb_hom_average_t0.75.parquet (642 groups, homolog-level cosine 0.75).
evidence_units.gen (diagnostic): genome lists, Lambda(n, E) with no correction, n >= 2.
evidence_units.ctxshuf (control): as ctx, but the context of a span is the one-gene context of a random slot (global permutation of slots, seed 17): real context marginals, no link to the instance.

method.updates: per round: (A) n, E (and group counts) for every live adjacency; (B) N_eff for adjacencies with Lambda(n, E) >= tau (ctx arms; Lambda_eff <= Lambda since N_eff <= n); (C) greedy commit in decreasing Lambda_eff (ties: left position, distance): an adjacency commits if its two nodes and the genes between them are unclaimed; (D) committed adjacencies become word nodes whose list is S (deduplicated spans, sorted by rank). Rounds repeat until nothing commits. Output = the parse.
method.tau: ladder {4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20}; tau* = smallest value whose round-0 instance FDR (mean over 3 gene-order shuffles of the adjacencies passing Lambda_eff >= tau and the structural minimum, divided by the observed count) is <= 0.01. Shuffle = genes permuted within each genome, contig sizes kept, seeds 1000 + r (softrec / engine null); the whole procedure (lists fixed, positions and contexts from the shuffled order) runs on it. The full-run word FDR at tau* (null word instances / observed word instances, 1 shuffle) is reported, not used for selection.
method.readings: V-top = top-level word instances; V-nest = V-top + their direct children that are words. No other reading rule.
method.classes: word classes for typing: graph on top-level word instances, edge w-v when a span of S_w covers >= 50% of its genes inside v and a span of S_v covers >= 50% inside w (mutual listing); Leiden modularity, resolution 1, seed 17; connected components reported too. Class id = module_id of the locus table.

reproduction_first: token DH even summed DF+TXSS excess .4270 (F1 .744/.548/.479, ribosomal 1,686/1,512, Parv 114/113) by rescoring the stored DH loci; per-instance F1 and control equal the stored scores

softrec stored statistic: the round-0 pass of this kernel with softrec round 2's genus lists (depth 1,000) and genus counting gives L, G, E equal to $RD/softrec/r2/stats/obs.npz (variant K1000_fnone) on every instance (E within float32 rounding)
odd_selection: per arm: reading among {V-top, V-nest} by (number of odd conditions met, odd summed excess); odd conditions = summed >= token DH odd - 0.01 (.4179), each caller F1 >= DH odd - 0.02, odd ribosomal recovered >= 830, Parvarchaeaceae recovered >= 54, resolved >= 705. Written to NOTEBOOK.txt before any even number of a word reading is read. The verdict output is ctx (K 1,000, W 50) at its tau* and selected reading; nothing else is tuned.
even_criterion: vs token DH (even, paired genome bootstrap 2,000 draws, seed 17): MATCHES if summed excess difference >= -0.01, each caller's F1 difference >= -0.02 (DF .744, TXSS .548, CCT .479), ribosomal recovered >= 1,650, Parvarchaeaceae recovered >= 110 of 114, resolved >= 1,400; BEATS if in addition the lower 95% bound of the summed-excess difference > 0. Also paired against stage-1 words (V-mob .6243) and the best softrec configurations (ws_cas fix gate_p1e-8 DH .4543, the one that matches; round-4 post DH .4920).

amendment_0.change: N_eff sample: at most 32 supporting genomes (not 64), and per sampled genome the context of its best-ranked supporting span only (ties: lowest start), in place of pooling all its spans. Reason: cost of 960-d window sums for every candidate; the null standard error of c_bar at k = 33 is about 0.08 x sqrt(2 / (33 x 32)) = 0.0035, small next to the context cosines that separate relatives (0.08-0.76).

deviations_from_brief_stated_in_advance: Rank weights do not enter the count (n and E are counts at a fixed depth, so that Lambda is a Poisson log-likelihood ratio in matched units; ws_cas found the Poisson G-vs-E tail at depth 1,000 separates rare true pairs from null far better than rank weights, AUC .935-1.00 vs .60-.76). Ranks order and prune lists and pick one supporting p per q.
Lists of the context arms exclude only the own genome (no genome groups at run time); the group arm excludes the own group, as lineagefree's token-free run of the same unit.
Reciprocity is not required; its share among the supports of committed round-0 merges is measured on a sample.
tau is set from round-0 instance FDR (one pass per shuffle) because full runs per ladder value are too costly at the instance level; the full-run word FDR at tau* is reported.

arms.grp (MAIN evidence unit): as declared for grp: emb lists outside the own group (emb_hom_average_t0.75, 642 groups), Lambda over group counts, n >= 2, depth 1,000
arms.syn (second arm; no groups, no threshold: genome-excluded emb lists (depth 1,000); synteny-retention matrix S(g, h) = share of genome g's supported round-0 adjacencies (non-excluded adjacencies with >= 1 supporting genome, depth-1,000 genome lists) that genome h supports, symmetrised (S + S^T) / 2, S(g, g) = 1, computed on each run's own gene order. For an adjacency with carriers C = own genome + supporting genomes (n = |C|, uniform weights), N_eff = n^2 / sum_{g,h in C} S(g, h), computed as n / (1 + (n - 1) s_bar) with s_bar = mean off-diagonal S over the own genome plus at most 63 supporting genomes chosen by the fixed random genome priority (seed 17) (an unbiased estimate of the mean pairwise S; used in place of a low-rank factor). Lambda_eff = Lambda_genome x N_eff / n; structural N_eff >= 2; tau by the same rule.

arms.z10.6, z13.7: ws_calib lists with the MAIN unit: own-group genomes excluded, group counts; everything else identical to grp
